rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet's prayer in prostration praises the One who created and formed him, ending with the praise, “Blessed is God, best of creators,” also found in 23:14.
rows.anchor: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ

none: The hadith concerns resisting corrupt successors and does not explain 28:81.
The report concerns rewards for accompanying a funeral; it does not explain 28:81.
The report concerns the reward or sin of calling others to guidance or error; it does not explain 28:81.
The report recounts Ali's praise of Umar and does not explain 29:29.

words: مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ
rows.speaker: أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ
rows.claim: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb identifies the lesser punishment as worldly calamities, the Romans, and either the assault or the smoke; Shuʿba is uncertain which of those last two was meant.
rows.anchor: عَنْ أُبَىِّ، بْنِ كَعْبٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ‏}‏ قَالَ مَصَائِبُ الدُّنْيَا وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ أَوِ الدُّخَانُ

none: The report describes judgment, the Fire, and intercession, but does not explain the plea in 40:49.

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that jinn, blocked from heavenly news, heard the Prophet reciting at dawn near Nakhlah, believed, and told their people; the report connects this event to the revelation of 72:1.
rows.anchor: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَا قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْجِنِّ وَمَا رَآهُمُ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ
rows.speaker: عبد الله
rows.claim: Abdullah reports that 17:57 refers to a group of jinn who became Muslims although people had worshipped them; their worshippers continued their worship.
rows.anchor: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَسْلَمُوا

none: The report asks what the Prophet's pulpit was made from; the similar wording to 80:18 is incidental.
The report concerns Badr and ransom; its phrase مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ is incidental to 80:18.
